ios.desc:
Miranda helps you visually find the best time to schedule international meetings and calls across different time zones. Stop wondering what time it will be in your city for that call with the business partners abroad.

— Coordinate the time across multiple time zones
— Change the time by scrolling the wheel 
— Interactive world map to accommodate the time of day
— Add meetings to calendar or share
— Fully-functional offline
— Dark and light modes for the user interface
— Beautiful user interface inspired by Dieter Rams

Miranda is built by a global digital agency tired of using cumbersome tools for scheduling their international calls. We’d love to hear your feedback and suggestions, so get in touch via the App Store “Support” link or email us at hello@sfcd.com.
